speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There's a great stone hall in the Blackfriars would hold a winter. I only say there is one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That was his sentence. I am not to give it a price, and I am not to give it a second hall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He stood in two cloaks and went back to the yard. The yard is the house we have. Enough.
